name: Textile spinning and weaving mills

problems.words: Looms stand idle half the shift because beams are not ready
quick_ideas: Ask the weaving master for one list of looms due for a new beam in the next few days and give it to preparation, so warping works to real need
Note the loom hours lost to beam waiting for one week, so the size of the problem is clear

workzap_build.text: A beam and preparation tracker that shows every day which looms are close to beam-out and which are waiting, updated by the shift in-charge.

problems.ask_first: Which part feels slowest — preparation, beams or the looms themselves?
problems.free_stops: How beam need is forecast and how preparation is sequenced is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one week, note each loom waiting for a beam and how long it stands, so beam delay is measured in lost weaving time.
Give one person the beam readiness list and evening handover to weaving, so loom changeovers stop waiting for verbal chasing.

problems.words: Efficiency on the looms is low but I don't know which shed or shift is worse
quick_ideas: For one shift, have output written loom-wise with the main stop reason, so weak looms show up
Compare one day shift and one night shift on the same looms, so the gap is based on a record

workzap_build.text: A shift log on phone per loom for picks and stop reasons, feeding an automatic morning efficiency view by shed, shift and loom type.

problems.ask_first: Is daily output recorded by loom or shed, or just as a total?
problems.free_stops: How efficiency is calculated and compared across sheds is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one day, compare each shed and shift by looms running versus looms stopped, so the weakest shed or shift stands out.
Give one person in each shift the same stoppage notebook, so shed and shift comparisons come from one consistent record.

problems.words: Waste is sold but the weight on the gate pass never matches
quick_ideas: Weigh one week's waste at the department where it is made and compare with the gate pass, so you know if the gap is real
Have two people sign the next waste weighing, so one person is not the only record

workzap_build.text: A waste register with weighing at source, automatic gate pass matching and a weekly view of waste by department.

problems.ask_first: Who weighs the waste when it goes out of the gate?
problems.free_stops: Where weighing points sit and how mismatches are flagged are covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one week, note waste weight at the department and again at the gate, so the mismatch is tied to a place.
Give one store person the waste register and gate handover each day, so outgoing weight is checked from one record.

problems.words: Gas pressure drops and we lose a whole shift
quick_ideas: Write down each gas or power interruption this week with hours and looms affected, so lost time is on paper
Put the most urgent orders on looms that can keep running on backup, so the important work is protected

workzap_build.text: An energy downtime log recording every interruption and lost hours, shown next to output in the owner's daily view.

problems.ask_first: How often does the gas drop, a few times a week or most days?
problems.free_stops: How downtime is costed and planned around is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one week, note each gas pressure drop with start time, end time and affected looms, so lost production from interruptions is visible.
Give one shift incharge the interruption notebook at every handover, so each pressure drop is recorded without chasing later.

problems.words: Yarn lots get mixed and the cloth shows shade variation
quick_ideas: Label every yarn lot in the godown clearly once, so lots cannot be mixed by accident
Note the yarn lot on the beam card for the next order, so a fault can be traced back

workzap_build.text: A lot tracker linking cotton lot to yarn lot to beam to cloth roll, so any roll can be traced in seconds.

problems.ask_first: Does the mix-up happen in the godown, or when the yarn reaches the looms?
problems.free_stops: How lots are linked through each stage is mapped in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For the next weaving order, compare yarn lot written at issue with lot used on the beam, so mixing points become visible.
Give one person the job of writing yarn lot on every beam card, so shade complaints can be traced to a single source record.

problems.words: Cloth is rejected for faults and nobody logs which loom made it
quick_ideas: Tag the next batch of rolls with loom number at doffing, so folding knows where each came from
Sit with the folding team for one day and note fault type against loom, so repeat offenders show up

workzap_build.text: A cloth fault log at folding with loom number, fault type and photo, summarised automatically by loom and jobber group.

problems.ask_first: Are the faults mostly from a few looms, or spread across the shed?
problems.free_stops: Fault categories and how they feed back to jobbers are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one day, count rejected rolls with no loom number versus total rejected rolls, so the missing traceability problem has a size.
Give one folding supervisor the roll log beside the table, so every rejected roll is tied to its loom before it moves on.

problems.words: Traders take cloth and pay in instalments over months
quick_ideas: Make one balance list per trader of deliveries, payments and what is still due, so nothing relies on memory
Decide a credit limit for your biggest traders, so the next delivery has a clear yes or no

workzap_build.text: A receivables ledger per trader and conversion party with ageing, and WhatsApp statements and reminders sent on schedule.

problems.ask_first: How do you keep track of what each trader owes now?
problems.free_stops: How limits are set and how statements are agreed with each party is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many trader part-payments arrived after the cloth was already fully lifted this month, so collection delay by trader type is visible.
Keep one trader dues notebook with one staff member and a fixed Saturday review, so every instalment follows the same follow-up routine.

problems.words: Conversion parties dispute how many metres we wove
quick_ideas: Pull together yarn received, metres delivered and rate for your most disputed party, so you have one clean record
Ask for a confirmation on the next delivery note, so the count is agreed on the day

workzap_build.text: A conversion work register for yarn in, metres out, rate and balance per party, with each delivery confirmed and the balance always current.

problems.ask_first: Is it one party who disputes the metres, or several?
problems.free_stops: How confirmations are captured and balances reconciled is covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one disputed conversion party, compare your delivery record with their claimed metres, so the disagreement is narrowed to one number.
Give one dispatch clerk the delivery notebook and same-day handover to accounts, so woven metres are recorded before disputes grow.

problems.words: I don't know my real cost per kg of yarn or per metre of cloth
quick_ideas: Put last month's raw material, power and labour totals next to output, so you have a rough cost per kg or metre
Do it for your two main counts or qualities, so a loss-maker stands out

workzap_build.text: A costing sheet per count or quality that updates with current cotton, power and labour rates and each month's output.

problems.ask_first: Which cost do you know least, the power, the labour or the waste?
problems.free_stops: How overheads and waste are spread across counts is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note one spinning lot's cotton issued, yarn packed and reprocessing returned on the same page, so your rough cost per kilogram reflects actual mill output.
Give one person one weekly page for cotton issued, yarn packed and cloth delivered, so cost checking uses the same mill figures every time.

problems.words: Owner calls three people every morning to know production
quick_ideas: Decide the four or five numbers you actually need each morning, so the calls have a purpose
Ask one person to collect them for you this week, so you stop being the collector

workzap_build.text: A daily owner summary of output, efficiency, waste, stoppages and dispatches, pulled automatically from the shift logs.

problems.ask_first: Which three people do you call, and what do you mainly ask each?
problems.free_stops: Which numbers go in and where they come from is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: For one morning, note when each production update reaches you and from whom, so delay between sheds and your desk is clear.
Give one supervisor the daily production roundup at a fixed morning time in one notebook, so your calls stop interrupting weaving work.

never_say: Any prediction of cotton prices or advice on when to buy or sell commodities.
Any advice on gas or power tariffs, gas allocation, sales tax refunds, export rebates or customs; suggest an accountant or the relevant authority.
Anything on fire, dust or machine-safety engineering; cotton godown fires and injuries are emergencies.
Any help misdeclaring count, weight or origin, or under-invoicing exports.
Any judgement on who is right in a dispute with a conversion party or trader.
Any guarantee of efficiency gains or lower waste.

sample_reply.person: Hamari 48 looms hain, efficiency ka kuch pata nahi chalta, aur beam ke intezar mein looms khari rehti hain. Koi solution hai?
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, iske liye kaafi kuch kiya ja sakta hai, aur shuruaat isi hafte ho sakti hai. 1) Ek shift ke liye production loom-wise likhwa lein aur saath mein rukne ki wajah, taa ke kamzor looms saamne aa jayen. 2) Weaving master se agle kuch din mein beam-out hone wali looms ki ek list le kar preparation ko de dein, taa ke warping asal zaroorat ke mutabiq ho. Workzap yeh sab aap ke liye roz khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: phone pe loom-wise shift log aur beam tracker, aur har subah shed aur shift ke hisaab se efficiency aap ke WhatsApp pe. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
